Subject: MAP Launch — SE/ML Introductions & 8‑Week Close Plan

Hi Samir + Leah,

Thanks again for the demo last week — great discussion. Per our conversation I wanted to kick off a short mutual action plan (MAP) and introduce the technical owners who will run the evaluation and help with ramping to production. High-level ask: align on the technical contact list, confirm a first technical sync next week, and lock an 8‑week close window so procurement has a target.

Who you'll meet from our side:
- Karthik Iyer (Solutions Engineer) — primary SE for integration, perf targets, and demo automation.
- Marcus Lin (ML Engineer) — model selection guidance, eval harness, and sample inference configs.

Draft timeline (attached: RDW_Polaris_MAP_8wk.xlsx):
1) Week 0 (this week): kickoff + inventory of data & infra requirements
2) Weeks 1–2: eval plan execution (sample traffic, latency/cost baseline)
3) Weeks 3–5: iterate on prompt engineering, quantization recommendations, and autoscaling tests
4) Week 6: production pilot and SLA validation
5) Weeks 7–8: contract finalization / go‑live prep

Quick asks for you to confirm:
- Primary technical lead (name + email) who will own the Polaris side of the eval
- Any org constraints (VPN, allowed egress, procurement blackout dates) that could affect the 8‑week window
- Preferred times for a 60‑minute technical kickoff next week (we've proposed two slots below)

Proposed kickoff slots (PT):
- Thu Jan 14, 10:00–11:00
- Fri Jan 15, 14:00–15:00

Attachments:
- RDW_Polaris_MAP_8wk.xlsx (MAP draft, milestones, owners)
- eval-checklist.md (evaluation artifacts we typically collect)

I'll follow up once you confirm times/owners — Karthik and Marcus will come prepared with a short checklist and an initial performance sketch.

Best,
Mina
Director, Solutions Partnerships
Redwood Inference
